title: The 'Hollows rested: X/6' / 'Hollows burned: X/6' split in status only appears after you've resolved your first hollow, so there's no early signal that burning a hollow counts the same as resting it toward the tally that opens Coldpass — I assumed burning was a worse/avoid path until the parallel counter showed otherwise.
where: status screen, on first appearance of the Hollows counters
